lines.text: Because the famine was severe, Abram went down to Moab to live there for a while.
Before entering Egypt, Abram asked his wife Sarai to say she was his sister so he would be spared.
Pharaoh's officials saw Sarai, commended her to Pharaoh, and she was taken into his palace.
Pharaoh treated Abram well and he acquired animals and servants, but the LORD afflicted Pharaoh and his household with severe plagues.
Pharaoh summoned Abram, asked why he had not said Sarai was his wife, and sent him away without his possessions.

wrong_details.true: with his wife and all his possessions
